description: DSL Glossary - SPL2 Domain-Specific Language vocabulary

api.description: Module node within a package; groups related methods under a common namespace; has state

api_overview.description: Overview document for an API. Inventory and top-level interface - what the API is, what it consists of, method signatures

branch.description: Non-leaf node with batch capability; can contain child nodes; base for module_root, package, api

clear.description: App-internal command to remove a specific context value; inverse of set

create.description: Method name for creation operations; bring something into existence that did not exist before

cycle.description: Method name for iterative execution; run one iteration of a repeating process with return-and-resume pattern

debug.description: Invocation flag to enable maximum verbosity output; diagnostic mode with full context

destroy.description: Method name for destruction operations; tear down and remove, freeing resources

dryRun.description: Invocation flag for preview mode; show what would happen without taking action; no side effects

execution.description: Request execution management API; handles pipeline execution within runtime context

extract.description: Method name for extraction operations; remove and retrieve something from a container or system

failFast.description: Invocation flag to stop on first failure; quiet mode that exits early on error

greet.description: Method name for outputting greetings; common behavior pattern

headers.description: Metadata component of Kafka-compatible record; hierarchical nested object

hello.description: Method name for announcing presence; common behavior pattern

install.description: Method name for installation operations; add components to existing structure

invoke.description: Method name for invoking a single method with execution context; atomic invocation

key.description: Primary key component of Kafka-compatible record; implements primary_key

major.description: First component of semver; increment for breaking changes

method.description: Invokable leaf node; contains implementation in index.js

minor.description: Second component of semver; increment for new backward-compatible features

module_node.description: Base structural type for SPL2 hierarchy; all nodes derive from module_node; has index.js with standard async signature

module_root.description: Root node of a module bundle; entry point for module-level operations

nopac.description: Invocation flag to skip confirmation prompt; opposite of pac; enables scripting mode

pac.description: Invocation flag to force confirmation prompt (Prompt And Confirm); enables functional help

package.description: Top-level module node; root of an API tree

patch.description: Third component of semver; increment for backward-compatible bug fixes

primary_key.description: Record identity in Kafka/streaming; determines partitioning, consumer groups, record set shaping

prXX.description: Reserved naming pattern for internal test packages; not for external deployment

report.description: Invocation flag to include structured data output; can specify level (report, report=detail, report=debug)

reset.description: App-internal command to reset all context to defaults; bulk clear operation

run.description: Method name for executing/starting a process; entry point

runtime.description: API for runtime context management; the context within which execution contexts run

runtime_id.description: Unique identifier for runtime execution instance

set.description: App-internal command to set a context value; establishes named context for subsequent operations

silent.description: Invocation flag for minimal output; topline level only

spl.description: Core Splectrum package; contains runtime infrastructure APIs

spl__dev.description: Dev Environment API for autonomous development with test-driven implementation; manages ephemeral dev environments and work package execution

start_time.description: Timestamp when something began; general initiation time marker

status.description: Method name for status query operations; report current state without modification (read-only)

submit.description: Method name for submission operations; provide work or input for processing

value.description: Contents component of key-value pair; used with designated key property

verb.description: App-internal command; single-word operation that cannot clash with package names (packages are nouns)

verbose.description: Invocation flag for detail output; full explanation mode

version.description: Version identifier using semantic versioning; platform-wide scheme
